name: Omnath, Locus of Rage
oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 5/5 red and green Elemental creature token.
Whenever Omnath or another Elemental you control dies, Omnath deals 3 damage to any target.
blocked_sentences: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 5/5 red and green Elemental creature token.

needs.what: a 5/5 red and green Elemental creature token (e.g. id elemental_5_5_rg)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids holds only elemental_1_1_ur, elemental_2_2_g, elemental_3_3_ur_flying and elemental_4_4_ur among Elementals, and the only 5/5 is dragon_5_5_r_flying; none matches the printed size, colors and creature type. The landfall trigger itself (permanent_enters filtered to Land you control) and the Elemental dies trigger are otherwise expressible.
